title: Concept: Password-based cipher without an IV via crypto.createDecipher (javascript) — review required
description: In javascript, crypto.createDecipher turns a passphrase into a cipher key and decrypts without an explicit IV. Repeated use of the passphrase repeats the keystream, which leaks plaintext relationships, and the legacy cipher offers no authentication. Use an AEAD cipher with crypto.createDecipheriv and a managed key.
applicability: javascript code that protects stored or transported data; lexical scope only.
risk: Plaintext recovery and undetected tampering; MEDIUM severity.
